title: Landing readiness check
description: Before landing, merge checks review stage, close-out evidence, lane identity, claim, dirty files, blocking QA, post-deploy QA and landing-route gates. The read-only --check uses the same checks. An item one declared edge before review is moved into review by the merge, running that stage's gates; --check asks the stage's database-claim prose gate read-only and reports a prose-vs-claim mismatch as a blocker, and its merge_will note names the stage's other gates, which only the merge's own transition evaluates. Every method records its start commit; a completed passing run from an ancestor of the lane candidate remains accepted without a new run. Foreign commits, newer failures or incomplete runs, changed configuration or target, missing subject proof and human review still block. Required merge-queue CI tests the final commit. Source-observed; not yet verified-live.
